scope.method: Git-derived tracked and untracked current frontend/shared contract/test/build/configuration paths, plus exact primary evidence; no recursive generated-audit inventory.
scope.source_count_boundary: Baseline/current core source counts exclude server/contracts/migrations and configuration, which are separately included. Inputs added since baseline remain separately recorded after they become Git-tracked; new_inputs only denotes current untracked nonignored inputs.

excluded.rationale: Separate completed native audit and generated evidence; shared native/web bridge scripts/tests and native workflow are explicitly included here.
Operational services/backup/monitor/deployment host files are outside this frontend source inventory. CI/deployment consumer references do not imply those files were fully read in this audit.

excluded.prefix: docs/ except docs/research, explicitly authored audit harnesses and listed root docs
excluded.rationale: Historical release/security/QA/audit records and other operational documentation are context, not newly audited frontend source. No arbitrary all-docs/full-read claim.

excluded.prefix: dist/, build/, node_modules/, .wrangler/, .forma-dashboard-assets/, work/, test-results/, playwright-report/
excluded.rationale: Reconstructible or private generated execution/dependency outputs; relevant recorded execution is summarized by dedicated reports/manifests.

review_methods.authored: All authored source/configuration/documentation input rows require complete exact-current-hash primary reading, or complete prior primary text plus an explicitly reviewed current patch. Secondary review is preserved without silently superseding primary evidence.
review_methods.structured_data: Catalogue/generated JSON, CSV and the dependency lock are every-entry parse/contract/integrity validations where stated, not claimed manual line-by-line source reading.
review_methods.binary: Header, full raster decode, complete stream metadata and font/XML validation remain distinct. A successful decode does not grant per-image visual/pose/rights approval.
review_methods.runtime: Reviewer execution statements are retained as evidence at their stated stage; TEST_RESULTS.md and dedicated metrics/screenshots govern final actual runtime totals. Static reading does not manufacture an execution pass.

guest_development.selection_count_provenance: Actual Playwright Running N tests headers, reconciled against final unannotated passed summaries; no separate --list invocation in CI.

guest_production_smoke.selection_count_provenance: Actual Playwright Running N tests headers, reconciled against final unannotated passed summaries; no separate --list invocation in CI.

account_development.selection_count_provenance: Actual Playwright Running N tests headers, reconciled against final unannotated passed summaries; no separate --list invocation in CI.
account_development.scope: Fresh real local API/PostgreSQL/mail-sink per profile plus intercepted synthetic race/design cases; not all checks are DB transactions.

account_production_build.selection_count_provenance: Actual Playwright Running N tests headers, reconciled against final unannotated passed summaries; no separate --list invocation in CI.
account_production_build.scope: Fresh real local API/PostgreSQL/mail-sink per profile plus intercepted synthetic race/design cases; not all checks are DB transactions.

totals.note: Executed checks, not 1,394 unique user journeys; browser scenarios repeat across projects and build modes.

final_completed_ci_verification.boundary: Per-row associated groups are not per-file line/branch coverage. Historical reviewer execution notes are preserved separately.

candidate_asset_inventory_reconciliation.explanation: The 1,020 candidate paths are 1,012 asset/catalogue/provenance primary rows plus 8 explicitly other-owner scripts, each represented by complete exact-current-hash source review. This inventory is a subset of the broader source/configuration ledger.

final_browser_execution_input_link.current_execution_assessment: Completed CI/local verification is recorded in final test receipts for these unchanged hashes; the snapshot itself is inventory.
final_browser_execution_input_link.status: all runtime input paths match exact-current reviewed inputs
final_browser_execution_input_link.boundary: This execution-input snapshot is inventory and hash linkage, not a substitute for primary reading or a claim that final browser matrices passed.

assets.boundary: Complete decoding integrity is distinct from visual/pose/coaching/rights approval.

postgresql.boundary: Isolated local service evidence; no global cluster or deployment claim.

runtime_preflight.evidence: Private after-final/BUILD_INPUT_LINK.json and immutable source-copy manifest; final native runtime remains tied to 3c27308.

native_runtime_source_link.boundary: Root log/doc result references may advance after web completion; unchanged native app/extension/core/UI/resource hashes remain tied to the actual native runtime commit. No new device execution inferred.

generated_evidence_review.method_boundary: Generated audit evidence is separate from authored source inputs. Preserve specialist full-size critical-subset inspection, whole-set structural checks, capture-phase boundaries and intermediate labels; no universal per-image visual/pose/rights approval.
